title: Board key: several boards in one browser, a paste field, SameSite=Lax
summary: Spec ready: scenario proves one cookie jar with 3 surfaces' boards, tabs, restarts; a page load with no key gets an HTML page with a paste field (key or whole link) via ?k=, and the client's denied notice too, nothing in web storage; cookie moves to SameSite=Lax, writes still guarded.
